description: Production-grade `dotnet new` templates for a .NET 10 Modular Monolith built on Clean Architecture, DDD and CQRS: per-module DbContext and schema, transactional outbox to RabbitMQ, a MediatR-free in-process dispatcher with a five-stage behaviour pipeline, Result/Error mapped to RFC 9457 ProblemDetails, RBAC with permission-based authorization, JWT auth with refresh and device sessions, Redis cache, S3/MinIO storage, SignalR, Quartz, Serilog and OpenTelemetry — plus unit, integration and NetArchTest architecture tests.
title: Modular Monolith · Clean Architecture Templates for .NET
